valid.code: const map = { a: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } };
valid.name: module-scope const map with inline multi-statement arrow - pre-built, not flagged

valid.code: class X { static map = { a: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
valid.name: static class field map with inline multi-statement arrow - pre-built, not flagged
single-expression arrow body (not a BlockStatement) - not flagged

valid.code: function build(items) { return items.map((x) => { let y = x; return y; }); }
valid.name: inline arrow callback argument, but call site is NOT inside a loop - not flagged

valid.code: const arr = [(x) => { let y = x; return y; }];
valid.name: bare array literal holding an inline arrow, not passed to any call - not flagged
default-parameter value is a single-expression arrow (not a BlockStatement) - not flagged

invalid.code: function build() { return { a: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: map rebuilt inside a function body on every call - flagged

invalid.code: class X { field = { a: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: non-static instance field rebuilds per instantiation - flagged

invalid.code: function build() { return { handler: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "handler" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { callback: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "callback" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { execute: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "execute" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { message: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "message" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { process: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "process" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { transform: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "transform" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { transformAsync: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "transformAsync" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { validate: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "validate" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { anyArbitraryKeyName: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: renaming the property key to an arbitrary name buys no escape - flagged identically

invalid.code: for (const it of items) { process(it, (x) => { let y = x; return y; }); }
invalid.name: inline arrow callback argument passed directly to a call inside a for-of loop - flagged (the textbook per-iteration-closure-allocation case)

invalid.code: while (hasNext()) { process((x) => { let y = x; return y; }); }
invalid.name: inline arrow callback argument inside a while loop - flagged

invalid.code: function build(cond) { return { a: cond ? (x) => { let y = x; return y; } : (x) => { let z = x; return z; } }; }
invalid.name: ternary-branched inline arrows as an object value in a rebuilt-per-call map - both branches flagged

invalid.code: function build(handler = (x) => { let y = x; return y; }) { return handler; }
invalid.name: default-parameter value is an inline multi-statement arrow closure - flagged

invalid.code: while (hasNext()) { register(Object.fromEntries([["a", (x) => { let y = x; return y; }]])); }
invalid.name: non-literal dispatch-table construction (Object.fromEntries) inside a loop - flagged

invalid.code: while (hasNext()) { register(new Map([["a", (x) => { let y = x; return y; }]])); }
invalid.name: non-literal dispatch-table construction (new Map) inside a loop - flagged
